_doc: Training-module SPECS (creator.trainmix.Target fields; lists become tuples). A new module is a new entry here (or a file in <runtime>/gpuday/trainmix/specs/, which autogen writes) - not code. Keys: name, size (0.6b|1.7b|4b), sources (creator.trainmix.SOURCES names), why, value, priority (lower first), module (eval kind: calib|brevity|promptbake|locate|judge|draft|aider|roles), filter ({'role': [...]} keeps those rows), max_seq, epochs, lr, batch, accum, packing, lora_serve, target_minutes, min_rows, pref, eval_minutes, vram_mib, hf_on_shm, requires (gates: 'adopted:<target>', 'rows:<source>>=N').

modules.name: calib_17b
modules.why: honest CONFIDENCE: the empirical pass rate of the kind of answer (training tasks only)
modules.value: high: a home model that knows when to ask the teacher saves the escalations it does not need

modules.name: brevity_17b
modules.why: shortest verified answer per task x role (+ DPO short vs long, both verified)
modules.value: high: fewer output tokens per pass = CPU time at home

modules.name: promptbake_17b
modules.why: role instructions baked in: the 1-line role tag replaces the long TEACHER_BRIEF text
modules.value: medium: prefill tokens saved on every role call at home

modules.name: locate_17b
modules.why: LOCATE: task -> files to change, from real public commits
modules.value: medium: the research step at home without the big model

modules.name: judge_06b
modules.why: 0.6B judgment adapter (0.6B retrieval@64 already 0.738 > 1.7B 0.456 on the ladder)
modules.value: medium: judgment at a third of the 1.7B's CPU

modules.name: voice_17b
modules.why: the terminal voice (creator.talk): understand + grounded speak rows

modules.name: draft_06b
modules.why: speculative-decoding draft for the pipeline 1.7B (distilled on the pipeline answers)
modules.value: high once pipeline_17b is adopted: 1.5-2.5x faster decode at home

modules.name: aider_17b
modules.why: Aider-format coder (Aider = the home default editor)
modules.value: high once the Aider rows exist (>= 300)

modules.name: calib_4b
modules.why: honest CONFIDENCE on the 4B (the stronger home model when a role needs it)
modules.value: high if the 4B is used at home

modules.name: pipeline_4b_mod
modules.why: every pipeline role on the 4B, combined multi-role run (LoRA served on the cached 4B GGUF)
modules.value: large if the 1.7B is not good enough at a role

modules.name: coder_4b
modules.why: a 4B coder on every verified coding source
modules.value: medium-high: the home coder when the 1.7B fails
